title: Power-of-Two-Choices Load Balancer
signature: def simulate_lb(requests, replicas, policy, pick2) -> dict
hints: Simulate events in time order with a heap. At equal times, process completions before arrivals: a slot that frees at t is free for a request arriving at t.
Outstanding = requests in service + requests queued at that replica. Increment it on assignment and decrement it on completion.
Call pick2() once per request, and only under the p2c policy. Prefer the first index on a tie.
Nearest-rank percentile: sort the latencies and take index ceil(q * n) - 1.
